capabilities: Search an authenticated Yandex Books library by title or author
Import one book's highlights and comments into a chosen vault folder and filename
Replace only the plugin-owned managed section on re-import while preserving other content
Refuse to overwrite unmanaged or mismatched notes
Store the Yandex OAuth token via Obsidian Secret Storage
extras: The plugin is unofficial and not affiliated with or endorsed by Yandex or Obsidian, and the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Yandex Books is the only supported provider and there is no background sync.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull book highlights and comments from a reading service into notes.

relations.evidence: imports highlights and comments from Yandex Books into Markdown notes

summary: Imports highlights and comments from Yandex Books into Markdown notes as a marker-delimited managed section.
